title: dcSweep
body:
## dcSweep

Steps one ideal grounded voltage source through evenly spaced DC values and reports the steady node voltages of a resistor network (capacitors act as open circuits). Outputs are results.csv (source voltage, then one column per probe in volts), circuit-summary.json and the generated netlist circuit.cir; every native value is checked against an independent nodal solution. Choose it for dividers, bridges and other resistive networks; use acSweep for frequency response and rcStep for a charging curve.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- start and stop are source volts and stop must exceed start; points includes both endpoints.
- Every node needs a path through resistors to ground or the source; a node reached only through capacitors is rejected as floating.
- Only ideal resistors and capacitors; semiconductors, models, subcircuits and imported netlists are not accepted.

Native binding: `ngspice dc`. Output kind: `["table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `circuit` | The circuit, written inline: one ideal voltage source between ground (node "0") and the source node, 1 to 64 resistors, up to 64 capacitors, up to 64 uncoupled inductors (acSweep only) and the nodes to publish. At most 16 non-ground nodes; no netlist, device model or subcircuit can be imported. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"default":"in"},"resistors":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"required":true,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"resistance":{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0,"required":true}}}},"capacitors":{"type":"array","maxItems":64,"default":[],"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"capacitance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-12,"maximum":1,"required":true}}}},"probes":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":16,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"default":["out"]}}}` | **required** |
| `start` | DC start is signed source volts (default 0); AC start is positive frequency Hz (default 1). stop must exceed start. rcStep always starts at zero seconds. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-1000,"maximum":1000}` | `0` |
| `stop` | DC stop is source volts (default 5), AC stop is positive Hz (default 10000), RC stop is seconds (default 0.005). RC duration must be 0.01–20 R*C time constants. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-1000,"maximum":1000}` | `5` |
| `points` | Number of evenly spaced samples including endpoints: 2–512 for DC/RC, 3–512 for AC; default 101. Finite samples cannot prove a continuous response envelope. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":512}` | `101` |
